objective: Independent review of the rebuild-path changes in the Microscope Memory engine: find any remaining path where a rebuild can lose indexed content, install a shrunken index, or drop pending append-log entries.

arms.mission: Review src/build.rs for the shrink guard and the append-log merge. Report: is the guard evaluated before the index files are written? Is the append-log merge deduplicating correctly against the mirror? Name concrete line numbers.
arms.completion: The shrink guard placement and the append-log merge dedup are reported with line numbers.
arms.stop_condition: The file has been read and analysed.

arms.mission: Read src/reader.rs and report every write path of a stored memory: the append log, the layer mirror, the timeline, and the auto-rebuild trigger. State which of them can fail without failing the store.
arms.completion: The store write paths and their failure behaviour are listed.

arms.mission: Read the repository AGENTS.md and list the test files, then report which existing test covers the rebuild/retention behaviour and whether the new guard changes any expected outcome.
arms.completion: The relevant test files and the expectations that the change affects are listed.
